memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Vitamin D deficiency
- Status: On cholecalciferol 60000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks; symptomatic fatigue mild.
- Plan: Continue loading for 8 weeks, then switch to maintenance 1000 IU OD; recheck 25‑OH‑D in 3 months.
Hypothyroidism
- Status: Levothyroxine 50 mcg OD; TSH pending.
- Plan: Keep dose; repeat TSH 6‑8 weeks after any change.
Generalised anxiety disorder
- Status: Escitalopram 5 mg OD, buspirone 5 mg BD; GAD‑7 to be done.
- Plan: Continue current regimen; monitor side effects.
Weight 62 kg, waist 84 cm (female cut‑off 80 cm – slightly increased).
Diet advice
- Breakfast: Whole grain toast with egg, avoid sugary cereals.
- Lunch: Dal, rice, vegetable curry, limit fried items.
- Dinner: Light soup, salad, early dinner by 7 pm.
Due: HbA1c not applicable – next due -
